purpose: Source-bound ownership inventory for non-soil-water-solver SWAP processes. No production physics is changed.

processes.label: crop / crop development
processes.readiness_reason: Large crop/calendar/WOFOST state surface, direct file readers and day-end growth/harvest sequencing require dedicated source-bound fixtures before structural migration.
notes: No direct HeadCalc access found in cropdevelopment; coupling occurs through plant globals and driver sequencing.

processes.label: root water uptake
processes.readiness_reason: Physics reads legacy hydraulic arrays h/theta and writes qrot sink fields used by the soil-water solve. Migration needs an admitted hydraulic_view and sink-result seam, not direct variables-module access.
notes: Current F-SI04 qualification is workspace replay only and therefore does not yet satisfy production admission.

processes.label: evapotranspiration / interception / meteo
processes.readiness_reason: ET and interception combine daily and sub-daily forcing, crop/snow/irrigation globals and file-backed record cursors. Reference fixtures must split forcing acquisition from process physics first.

processes.label: subsurface drainage
processes.readiness_reason: Drainage uses groundwater head and timestep directly and contributes qdra/qdrtot inside the soil-water retry loop. It must consume an explicit hydraulic view and return fluxes without owning solver transaction semantics.

processes.label: irrigation / SSDI
processes.readiness_reason: Scheduling maintains event counters, calendar windows and rates in SAVE state and reads h/theta for trigger rules. A reusable process checkpoint boundary is needed before migration of scheduling state.
notes: SSDI qssdi is optional state and must not be allocated for inactive columns in the new architecture.

processes.label: surface water / ponding / runoff / runon
processes.readiness_reason: Surface storage, runoff/runon and extended drainage are interleaved with solver boundary/retry behavior. Production migration must wait for a shared transaction plus solver seam.

processes.label: snow accumulation / melt

source_files.role: legacy parameter loading; B1.10 patched by SWAP-013 but snow parameter semantics unchanged

processes.readiness_reason: The snow process body is compact, has no direct solver-internal dependency and is the best first seam. Production migration is held only by governance until a qualified shared downstream baseline exists.
notes: Driver currently invokes snow task 2 only at flDayStart; this is a hidden caller time assumption, not intrinsic to the snow equations.

processes.label: macropore flow
processes.readiness_reason: Macropores are optional and deeply embedded in SoilWater retry/state restoration. Preserve reference physics, but defer migration until the reference soil-water isolation seam covers this path.
notes: No macropore persistent state may exist for columns with swmacro=0 in the target architecture.

processes.label: frozen-soil conductivity/boundary
processes.readiness_reason: FrozenCond changes conductivity-reduction fields and FrozenBounds changes solver boundary behavior, so a stable solver-facing contract is required.

processes.label: soil temperature
processes.readiness_reason: Persistent temperature profile is physically meaningful and couples to snow, frost, oxygen stress and crop logic. A dedicated fixture is needed before extraction.

processes.label: tillage / hydraulic-property event
processes.readiness_reason: Legacy tillage mutates hydraulic parameters plus h/theta/pond and performs redistribution. Ownership between immutable parameters, committed state and event-generated parameter state must be resolved explicitly before migration.

processes.label: solute transport / age tracer
processes.readiness_reason: Optional solute transport is substantial and consumes q/qtop/qbot/qrot/qdra. Defer until water-process seams and optional state ownership are stable.

processes.label: soil nutrient management / WOFOST soil
processes.readiness_reason: Optional nutrient/soil-management stack has broad I/O and WOFOST dependencies and is outside the first water-process migration tranche.

global_holds: No production process migration on this branch.
No F-KT05 semantics consumed until qualified.
F-SI04 source-bound workspace replay evidence is informative only; no production solver seam is consumed.
A shared qualified downstream F-KT/F-SI integration baseline is required before F-PM02 production source changes.
